subject: maths

topics.topic: Number: Numbers and the number system
covers: Count on and back in steps of any size, including past zero, and extend number sequences.
Say what each digit means in numbers up to one million, and partition them.
Multiply and divide numbers up to 10 000 by 10 or 100 and see the effect.
Read, write and compare decimals to two places and fractions with tenths and hundredths.
Order and compare negative and positive numbers on a number line and temperature scale, and work out a rise or fall.
Round whole numbers and decimals to the nearest 10, 100, 1000 or whole number.
Change improper fractions to mixed numbers and find simple fractions and percentages of quantities.
Use ratio and proportion to solve problems, such as scaling a recipe.
Multiply two-digit numbers by two-digit numbers, and multiply a decimal with one place by a single-digit number.
Divide three-digit numbers by single-digit numbers, with and without remainders.
Decide whether to round an answer up or down after division, depending on the context.
Use brackets to set the order of operations.
